params.body:
Vera, the review product, is removed, and Portal no longer accepts a word signed for `#agent-vera`.

- `hand.mjs admit` drops `--hand vera` and `--act`. A word for a single act only ever existed for that hand. `admit` now signs words for the workbench only.
- `admittedKinds` drops its Vera branch. `lib/policy.test.mjs` drops the Vera rows.
- The comments that pointed at Vera's machine now name the workbench at home, the other machine that fetches an admission from Portal. The comments touched are now in English.

Rebased on `main` after #61 to #63. `node --test lib/*.test.mjs`: 48 of 49. The failure (`a machine that never reached the platform falls back to the bundled snapshot`) fails the same way on `main`.
params.title: Remove the Vera hand from admit: the workbench is the only hand words are signed for
